decision_order.question: Does the delivery conform to the frozen offer (model, specs, colour, condition, quantity, accessories, images, price, delivery terms), weighing the contestable delivery evidence?
Was the purchase caused by the merchant's offer: instructions in merchant-controlled content, or items/fees the merchant added that the agent did not choose?

Did the agent break an explicit, machine-readable term of the signed mandate or Allowance Policy (AG1-P), or did it fail to capture into the mandate it drafted an explicit requirement the user stated in the conversation, and buy something that misses it (AG1-C, capture failure)?
Otherwise the buyer bears it; the statutory withdrawal right still applies.

AG3.name: Non-conformity
AG3.test: The delivered item does not conform to the frozen offer (model, specs, colour, condition, quantity, accessories, images, price, or delivery terms), including non-delivery and counterfeit goods. Applies whatever the agent did.

AG4.name: Injection via merchant content
AG4.test: The delivery conforms, but the agent bought the items because it followed instructions embedded in content the merchant controls or hosts (listing text, hosted reviews, merchant profile).

AG1-M.name: Merchant-added items
AG1-M.test: The delivery conforms, but the merchant added or pre-selected items or fees that the agent did not choose.

AG1-P.name: Agent fault on the record
AG1-P.test: The delivery conforms and the offer was not manipulative, but the agent broke an explicit, machine-readable term of the signed mandate or Allowance Policy: a hard limit (amount, category, merchant rule, units, expiry, required approval or notification), a captured item requirement (condition, colour, model, spec, size, region or plug, minimum discount), or a captured clarify-if-ambiguous flag.

AG1-C.name: Capture failure
AG1-C.test: The user stated an explicit requirement to the agent in the conversation; the agent drafted the mandate without capturing it as a machine-readable term; the purchase misses that requirement. The agent provider is liable for the failure to capture.

AG2.name: Authorised but wrong
AG2.test: The delivery conforms, the offer was not manipulative, the purchase meets every explicit mandate term, and the missed requirement was never stated to the agent (an unstated wish). If the user had stated it in the conversation, see AG1-C.

AG5.name: User error, change of mind, or friendly fraud
AG5.test: The delivery conforms and the purchase matches the explicit mandate and recorded intent; the complaint comes from the buyer's own instruction, a change of mind, or a claim the evidence contradicts.

remedies.refund: The disputed amount goes back to the buyer, paid by the liable party; non-conforming goods go back at the merchant's cost.
remedies.withdrawal: No fault remedy, but the statutory withdrawal right is available: the buyer may return the goods within 14 days of delivery for a refund, paying return costs.
remedies.deny: No remedy: no fault of another party and no withdrawal right available.

card.merchant: reversal against the merchant through the card network's chargeback mechanism
card.agent_provider: agent provider credits the buyer's card account
card.buyer_withdrawal: merchant refunds to the card after receiving the returned goods (buyer pays return shipping)

a2a_instant.merchant: merchant pushes a refund credit transfer (no rail chargeback exists; the obligation comes from programme participation)
a2a_instant.agent_provider: agent provider pushes a credit transfer to the buyer
a2a_instant.buyer_withdrawal: merchant pushes a refund credit transfer after receiving the returned goods (buyer pays return shipping)

exceptions: digital_content once delivery started with consent
custom_goods made to the consumer's specification

capture_duty.rule: If the user stated an explicit requirement to the agent in the conversation and the agent, which drafted the mandate, did not capture it as a machine-readable term, the agent provider is liable (AG1-C).
capture_duty.precedes: AG2 (authorised but wrong applies only to requirements never stated)
